rationale: Realtime processing dominates and at least one durable replay-capable source is present.
Historical volume/retention/variety favors an open, governed lakehouse layer.
Multiple heterogeneous sources or an explicit federation requirement exists.
Common metadata, policy, lineage, quality and discovery are needed across sources.
reconsider_when: freshness or throughput changes by more than 2x
a source becomes non-replayable or retention is reduced
team operations maturity or deployment policy changes
representative benchmark contradicts the heuristic decision
